pages.text: The $(item)Data Scrubbing Tower$() is a 5×9×5 tiered fractionating tower that cleans raw telemetry logs into $(item)High-Purity Domain Datasets$() and $(item)Clean Datasets$(), while separating $(item)Corrupted Noise$() and rare $(item)Golden Datasets$().$(br2)Later in IV, it also hosts the Inference Hatch for CWU/t power discounts.

pages.title: 5×9×5 Tower Structure
pages.text: $(li)$(#0E7490)Pedestal (5×2×5)$(): Clean Stainless Steel Casings; controller sits front-center on layer 2. Put Item Import/Export, Fluid Import, Energy, Maintenance, and (in IV) up to 1 Inference Hatch here.$(li)$(#0E7490)Body (3×5×3)$(): 1×5×1 Titanium Pipe core wrapped in Cleanroom Glass, framed by Titanium Frame corner columns and ring beams.$(li)$(#0E7490)Cap (5×2×5)$(): EV Machine Casings and Grate Casings. Fix maintenance before running.

pages.title: Scrubbing & Noise Recycling
pages.text: $(li)$(#0E7490)Scrub Mining/Chemical Log$() (2048 EU/t × 200t): 1 Raw Log + 1000 mB Distilled Water → 1 High-Purity Domain Dataset + 1 $(item)Clean Dataset$() + $(bold)9/10$() chance Corrupted Noise + $(bold)1/10$() chance Golden Dataset.$(li)$(#0E7490)Noise Recycling$() (1024 EU/t × 100t): 4 Corrupted Noise + 250 mB Distilled Water → 1 Silicon Dust.$(br2)Clean Datasets craft 4× Blank Carriers and later feed the IV satellite cloud.
